profile.name: 数字微镜图案投影器
profile.description: 这是一种基于数字微镜器件（DLP/DMD）的可编程光图案投影设备，可通过红绿蓝发光二极管与微镜阵列输出静态图像、掩模、线条、光斑及时序图案。在实验室中常用于结构光照明、掩模投影、扫描照明、系统标定和显微成像中的图案化激发。
profile.description_en: This is a programmable light pattern projector based on a digital micromirror device (DLP/DMD). Using RGB LEDs and a micromirror array, it can project static images, masks, lines, spots, and timed pattern sequences. In the lab it is commonly used for structured illumination, mask projection, scanning illumination, system calibration, and patterned excitation in microscopy.

This is a programmable light pattern projector based on a digital micromirror device (DLP/DMD). Using RGB LEDs and a micromirror array, it can project static images, masks, lines, spots, and timed pattern sequences.
